import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)

	scanner.Scan()
	parts := strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
	h1, _ := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
	h2, _ := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])

	scanner.Scan()
	parts = strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
	a, _ := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
	b, _ := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])

	pos := h1 + 8*a
	dc := 0
	for {
		if pos >= h2 {
			fmt.Println(dc)
			return
		}
		if 12*a <= 12*b {
			fmt.Println(-1)
			return
		}
		pos -= 12 * b
		pos += 12 * a
		dc++
	}
}
